messages:
rachel_cs: Customer Alex reported a rerank API failure when they attach a long query + 120 short docs. Error says 'payload too large' but customer insists tokens alone shouldn't hit the cap. They sent a repro curl.
sam_support: Can you drop the curl and the exact error JSON here? Also which model + reranker endpoint? Need to know if this is the rerank v1 endpoint or the /ranker legacy route.
rachel_cs: Repro pasted below. They call `POST /v1/rerank` with model `open-rerank-small`.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_XXX' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"query":"<very long user query: ~3200 chars>","documents":[{"id":"d1","text":"..."}, ..., {"id":"d120","text":"..."}]}'
```
Error response:
```json
{ "error": "413 Payload Too Large", "message": "request size exceeds rerank input limits (tokens)" }
```
emily_swe: Thanks — quick hypothesis: the customer query alone might balloon tokenized size because of weird unicode/HTML. Ask them to send the raw `query.length` and tokenized count (we internally count tokens via GPT-like tokenizer). Also confirm if their docs are full HTML blobs.
mike_oncall: Short-term workaround: tell customer to trim query to first 1024 chars and split docs into pages of 25. Long-term we should return structured error: include `limit_type` (tokens/docs/count), `max_allowed`, and `actual` so customers can programmatically handle it.
support-bot: Incident note created: INC-2024-834, assigned to eng-ml for reranker-limit-ux.
sam_support: Rachel — can you ask Alex to run this quick tokenizer check and paste the token count? Example helper JS:
```js
const {encode} = require('@redwood/tokenizer');
console.log(encode(longQuery).length);
```
rachel_cs: Sent their token count: query -> 5600 tokens, docs combined -> ~18000 tokens. Customer surprised because they thought character limits map 1:1 to tokens.
emily_swe: That explains it. 5600 tokens for a query is > our rerank input cap (we cap per-request to ~8k total tokens across query+docs for that model). Docs pushed them over. Suggestion: we should update docs + error message to say "tokenized input" and include token numbers.
mike_oncall: Also flagging a UX issue: the UI/SDK should proactively warn when the posted JSON > 1MB as a heuristic. For now, help customer with chunking pattern and recommend embedding-first retrieval then rerank top-K.
sam_support: I'll send customer a step-by-step: 1) show token counts + how to trim, 2) example to paginate docs and rerank each page, 3) alternative flow: embeddings -> top 50 -> rerank top 10. Will ask for permission to escalate to Dedicated if throughput/size is a hard requirement.
rachel_cs: Customer is okay with pagination for now but requested clearer error wording and a sample snippet. I'll follow up and paste their confirmation here. :thumbsup:
